name: What factors affect the cost of shingle repair versus replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of shingle repair versus replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost difference between shingle repair and replacement depends on the extent of the damage, the type of shingles, and the age of your existing roof. Minor damage to a few shingles can often be repaired affordably. However, if damage is widespread, covers a large percentage of the roof, or if your roof is near the end of its lifespan, a full replacement often becomes the more cost-effective long-term solution. A professional assessment will help determine the most economical option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include damage extent, shingle type, and roof age; extensive damage or an old roof usually makes replacement more cost-effective.
